scenes.title: A corntastic day!
scenes.titleZh: 祝你有玉米般美好的一天！
scenes.practice: Give a cheerful wish, echo a surprising phrase, and explain a pun. Corntastic combines corn and fantastic; it is wordplay, not a standard adjective.
scenes.editNote: Continuous source interval. Preserve the family laughter and the child’s What? before the explanation. No song remix or generated speech.

verification.sourceContext: Inspected source frames/captions and independent tiny.en recognition on 55–74 seconds, including material beyond both cut boundaries.
verification.dialogue: Draft corrected against burned-in captions; source automatic captions and tiny.en disagree on parts of the first wish and pun. Human listening must confirm wording and timing before pack authoring.
verification.roles: Source frames identify Tariq delivering the wish and explanation; Julian repeats the wish as a question. The woman’s laughter remains in the original audio.
verification.cut: Draft cut begins after the preceding dollar answer, retains the corn release and laughter, and stops before the next sentence around 72.7 seconds. ASR word times are supporting evidence, not proof of final syllable completeness.
